description: Verdict (the security marketplace for DeFi) rates DeFi across 7 entity types: protocol, chain, token, oracle, vault, organisation, bridge. Search those ratings by name or keyword, and pass entity_type to narrow to one type. Returns matching entities with their letter grade + composite score. Example: search_ratings({ query: 'aave' }).

entity_type.description: Optional: restrict to one entity type. Omit to search all 7 types at once.

query.description: Name or keyword to search for, e.g. 'aave' or 'chainlink'.

name: search_ratings
title: Search Verdict ratings
